headline: The Pakistan Stock Exchange launched a Shariah-compliant trading counter on Thursday, with 39 brokers onboarded through Islamic windows and trading limited to Shariah-compliant equities and Islamic instruments.

card.desc: Only Shariah-compliant stocks; no short selling or derivatives.

caption:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange launched a Shariah-compliant trading counter on Thursday, with 39 brokers onboarded through Islamic windows, Business Recorder reports. Trading is limited to Shariah-compliant equities and Islamic instruments, and short selling and derivatives are not permitted, Arab News adds.
